name: Button
purpose: The AuthCard's action control. One component for every variant; light mode is the `.light` ancestor cascade restyling the same classes in place.
supersedes: CLONE_SPEC says the hero card uses `.button-hero` / `.input-hero`. The real DOM uses `.button-outline` / `.input-solid`. Cite these.
rule: There is NO `-light` button variant. Light appearance comes from a `.light` ancestor only.
